name: 2-SAT Mechanism Camouflage
description: Replaces the abstract graph-coloring failure condition with the step-by-step operational mechanics of a 2-SAT contradiction. Pattern-matching models will likely attempt to build a directed implication graph and search for 6-cycles (which is complex and prone to TLE/errors), while reasoning models will deduce that a 3-variable contradiction simply requires all 3 edges (a triangle) and use the intended efficient bitset intersection.
